critical_code_review_comments: handler.ts: ingress order is correct and minimal — method(405) → disabled(semantic 503) → auth(401) → pilot(403) → size(413) → json → handle(). The caller's identity is built from the verified token ONLY ({ uid: user.uid }); depsFor is NOT invoked before the pilot check. Ingress JSONs are {ingress, correlationId} without contract keys. Verified empirically with ingress spy (depsCalls invariant on 401/403/413/405 and on flag OFF).

auth.ts (verifyUserJwt): rejects non-HS256 (alg 'none' and HS384 all → null), non-UUID sub, exp*1000<=nowMs, role!='authenticated'; signature verified via WebCrypto HMAC/SHA-256. No fallback to claims when verification fails.
env.ts: GPTOUR_SEMANTIC_V2_ENABLED defaults to false (flag OFF), allowedUids built from the explicit UID CSV only, userJwtSecret missing → fail-fast with no default. maxBodyBytes=64KB.

adapters/catalog-postgrest.ts: both makePostgrestCatalog and makePostgrestSettings forward the user's JWT in Authorization: Bearer, so PostgREST applies RLS on auth.uid() (confirmed by lab_u2d.py: rls_B=[{'name':'Torino'}] restricted set). No service-role bypass.

turn.ts: catches DependencyError (planner/routing) and releases a semantic 503 dependency_unavailable with outcome='recoverable', plan=null, gate=null, retryableSameRequest=true. No invented 'no candidates' outcome. get_request returns pending until the lease is expired, then the same requestId can be retried and committed.
Scope minimal: ONLY the 5 authorized U1 files are tracked diffs vs 259ec92d; handler.ts/auth.ts/env.ts/adapters are present but untracked; migration SQL md5 byte-identical.
Kit JSON and evidence logs contain no 'eyJ' JWTs and no secrets (grep clean) — PII and credentials isolated.

rca of the issue: No defect.
